adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking, the new DB fallback fetches a raw Prisma credential via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` and passes it directly to `getCalendar(calendarCredential)`. Unlike other new/modified call sites in this diff (e.g. EventManager) that fetch `credential` with `include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}` and map to an object containing `appName`, this fallback does not include/map app info. The finding’s hard claim that `getCalendar` dispatches on `credential.appName` (and therefore deletion will *definitely* be a no-op) is not shown in the diff, but the inconsistency is real and could cause `getCalendar` to return null if it relies on app metadata, which would skip `deleteEvent` due to optional chaining.
